title: MZ [SOLVED] I want to remove the actor selection menu when i am using an item/key..

posts.author: TheRamenGirl
posts.body:
Hello
wow mz is making me extra tired...
I want to remove the actor selection menu when i am using an item/key..
can someone help please?
i tried Galv's
MV Single Actor Menu Target
but it's not working for me.. (maybe cuz i use MZ)?
anyway

..
Thanks!

posts.author: FrigidGaze
posts.body:
Hiya,
If you set the scope of the item to 'none' it should bypass all that and just go straight to the map when you use it! Or is the plugin you're using causing something weird to happen on that end?

posts.author: TheRamenGirl
posts.body: YOOO my mann it worked!! you are the best!! thanks!
